title.ko: 민감정보의 공개 가능성 및 비공개를 선택하는 방법

rules.statement: If information made public while providing goods or services may include sensitive data, state that it may be disclosed, naming the sensitive items as clearly as possible.
Give the concrete procedure and menu path to choose non-disclosure.
Services built on public communication (open boards, SNS) where users know their own input is public may omit this section.

riskSignals: user-created folders or lists public by default
health or fitness records with a share or public feature
real-time body metrics shown to other members
SNS fields such as sexual orientation or political views visible to non-members
goodPatterns: Table: service | sensitive items | how disclosure can happen | how to choose non-disclosure (warning pop-up with a link, plus menu path).

commonDefects.defect: Health/fitness app shares metrics publicly but the policy has no S12 section.
Opt-out described vaguely ('설정에서 변경') without a path.

extractionHints: health, heart rate, body fat, sexual life, beliefs, political views

PIPA:23(1).note: scope of sensitive data, with Decree 18

needsVerification.note: Full list of sensitive-data categories (PIPA 23(1), Decree 18) is not reproduced in the guideline; do not enumerate it in clauses.
